collection.title: Mitsubishi Shogun 1983 to 1991 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mitsubishi Shogun 1983 to 1991 model which requires a 16" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Shogun, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
